dim_1_hook_velocity.feedback: Perfect execution. Hook is strictly 2.1s (well under the 2.5s limit) and uses 9 punchy words.

dim_2_retention_velocity.feedback: Excellent pacing. All 19 shots are subdivided into micro-shots of 3.0 seconds or less. Total word count is 138, fitting the 130-155 criteria.

dim_3_show_dont_tell.feedback: Strong visual mapping. The UI screencasts trace perfectly with the spoken script, leveraging Riley Brown-style fast pacing.

dim_4_visual_metaphors.feedback: Significant improvement over Draft V1. B-roll prompts are well-defined, providing clear instructions for isometric and UI-based motion graphics.

dim_5_mode_versatility.feedback: Distinct and fleshed-out directions for both Mode A (Standalone) and Mode B (On-Camera). Body language and PiP transitions are explicit.

dim_6_audio_cadence.feedback: Comprehensive audio map. SFX (sub-booms, swooshes, clicks) and transitions are effectively planned out for each micro-shot.

dim_7_bookmark_utility.feedback: Excellent Sabrina Ramonov blueprint implementation. A literal, copy-pasteable 3-step prompt is provided along with a clear $0 free software stack takeaway.

dim_8_zero_dollar_compliance.feedback: Highly feasible B-roll prompts that avoid expensive 3D rendering. All UI and visual metaphors can be synthesized with free tools like Gemini and Antigravity's built-in image generator.
